item.title: Body of missing Kerry man found in woodland near his South Kerry farm
item.description: Gardaí are reporting that the body of a missing Kerry man has been found in woodland near his farm near Sneem within the past 90 minutes. 72-year-old Jeremiah Downing was reported missing after being last seen on the N70 at around 5pm on New Year’s Eve. Over the past few days searches had been taking place to locate Mr Downing and they involved Gardaí, the Iveragh Coastguard and Derrynane CRBI as well as local volunteers. item.title: Henry Shefflin steps down as Ballyhale boss
item.description: Henry Shefflin has stepped down as Ballyhale Shamrocks manager, ahead of becoming Kilkenny's under-20 hurling boss. Shefflin led his home club to two All-Irelands in his first stint in charge, but his second spell was ended by a loss to Saint Martin's in last month's Leinster final. Advertisement

item.title: Cacace will bid to become two time world champion in the 3Arena in March
item.description: Irish super-featherweight Anthony Cacace will aim to become a two-time world boxing champion at Dublin's 3Arena in March. The Belfast fighter will take on Liverpool's Jazza Dickens for the WBA title on Saint Patrick's weekend. Also on the card, Dublin's Pierce O’Leary goes up against Mark Chamberlain for the vacant IBO world super-lightweight championship. Advertisement

item.title: Idah a doubt for Ireland with hamstring injury
item.description: Adam Idah is a doubt for the Republic of Ireland's World Cup play-off against Czechia in March. Swansea manager Vitor Matos has confirmed that the striker will be out for a prolonged period of time with a "significant" hamstring injury. Ireland are already without Burnley midfielder Josh Cullen, who has ruptured his anterior cruciate ligament. Advertisement

item.title: Frawley starts for Leinster against future employer Connacht
item.description: Ciaran Frawley will start for Leinster against his future employers Connacht in the United Rugby Championship tomorrow. He's been picked at full-back with Sam Prendergast at out-half for the reigning champions - who are captained by Dan Sheehan. Dave Heffernan and Jack Carty are both out through injury for Connacht but Ireland internationals Bundee Aki, Cian Prendergast and Finlay Bealham all start for Stuart Lancaster's side. item.title: Brennan Johnson makes to move across London to Crystal Palace
item.description: Crystal Palace have completed the club record signing of Brennan Johnson from Tottenham. They've paid 35-million-pounds for the Wales international, who has signed a four and a half year deal at Selhurst Park. Brighton have re-signed midfielder Pascal Gross from Borussia Dortmund on an 18-month deal. And Bournemouth have signed experienced goalkeeper Fraser Forster on a short-term contract. Advertisement

item.title: Woman falls into Dingle Marina during New Year’s Eve festivities
item.description: A woman fell into the water at Dingle Marina during the New Year’s Eve festivities. Gardaí received the report at around 19:40 on Wednesday. She was taken to University Hospital Kerry for treatment. Advertisement Meanwhile, a man in his 20s has been released after he was arrested in Dingle on New Year’s Day, and taken to Tralee Garda Station. item.title: Humanity Ball in Tralee raises €250,000 for charities
item.description: The Humanity Ball in Tralee on New Year’s Eve raised €250,000 for three charities. The ball was held in the Ballygarry Estate Hotel and Spa on New Year’s Eve, and was spearheaded by Stephen Stack and Seán Ryan among others. It aimed to raise €150,000, but surpassed this to raise a quarter of a million euro from this event alone.
